name: operations.demands

list.description: Read full native funding-demand tasks within the verified inquiry scope.

parameters.name: from-time
parameters.description: Inclusive native execution-time lower bound YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, without an offset; Beijing GMT+08:00.

parameters.name: to-time
parameters.description: Inclusive native execution-time upper bound YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, at or after from-time; Beijing GMT+08:00.

history.modification_time: gmtModified (native offset-free local clock; timezone not inferred)

get.description: Read one complete native detail root; separate histories and child endpoints are unqueried.

lookup.name: taskId
lookup.description: Native FUND_REQUIRE taskId from the List; sourceId is a different reference.

result_identity.description: Native returned taskId; validated against the requested lookup without changing its type.

purpose: Inspect native funding-demand tasks through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: taskId
fields.meaning: Native task identity, distinct from sourceId.

fields.name: sourceId
fields.meaning: Associated source reference; not the task primary identity.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Finite native decimal text, retained without numeric conversion.

fields.name: executeTime
fields.meaning: Native execution timestamp; Beijing GMT+08:00, distinct from capture time.

fields.name: gmtModified
fields.meaning: Native modification clock ordering versions of one task; preserved independently of executeTime and without inferred timezone.

identity_description: Native taskId identifies one returned record within the tenant and exact acquisition scope.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant and FUND_REQUIRE source. One GET /riskActionTaskQuery.json uses a serialized riskActionTaskQueryVO, rowStart=0 and pageSize=5000.

Both offset-free execution-time bounds are required. Public values use T; wire values use a space. Equal bounds are permitted and native boundaries are inclusive. Offset-free execution times use owner-confirmed Beijing GMT+08:00.

Native result.dataValue records and result.count describe the queried task scope. Counts or arrivals above 5000 are rejected; narrow the bounds. No offset fallback, automatic partitioning or alternate source.
Ordinary List: All native fields, types, nesting and unknown values are retained. No detail lookup, source join or status interpretation.

The host SDK owns retries, completeness and publication. Standard latest_by selects the complete latest row per taskId by strictly validated gmtModified; its offset-free local calendar/clock ordinal is internal and does not invent a timezone or Unix instant. Native fields remain unchanged. Resolved versions/ties warn and can be complete; missing/invalid modification clocks fail and real count/traversal gaps retain their coverage meaning.
Native result.riskActionVO only; same-envelope decision/execution report siblings and separate child/history endpoints are outside this Get.
Get and supported List --live --with-detail preserve native types, nesting and unknown fields, perform no implicit history/child inquiries, and write no cache or Duckdog data.
